levels.label: existence
levels.alt: a lone human figure stands on the curved night side of the Earth, its city lights glowing, under a deep blue sky of stars, the Milky Way and three spiral galaxies, with the sun about to rise at the horizon on the left
levels.caption: stars colored by their temperature, spiral galaxies on logarithmic arms and a Milky Way grown from noise, above the Earth's lit rim. the galaxies are stylized, not a map of the sky

levels.label: rhythm
levels.alt: turquoise points of light on a dark teal ground: a wave of pendulum bobs runs across the top, and below a wavy line, scattered flashes gather from left to right into neat vertical columns, over faint rings of interfering waves
levels.caption: coupled oscillators: a pendulum wave, two interfering wave sources, and fireflies flashing as Kuramoto oscillators that fall into step as their coupling grows. the synchrony is drawn qualitatively, not measured from real fireflies

levels.label: mathematics
levels.alt: a violet wireframe dodecahedron with a cube nested inside it, its edges dissolving into points toward a golden-angle spiral of dots at the upper right, with small polyhedra in bubbles and faint equations scattered over a grid
levels.caption: Platonic solids nested as Kepler nested them, a phyllotaxis spiral and the equations of physics, breaking from crisp lines into points. that mathematics is what reality is made of is an interpretation, not an established result

levels.label: fabric
levels.alt: two indigo wireframe sheets, one below and one overhead, dip into glowing wells around bright masses, while glowing strings stretch between them in two rows toward a tangled, glowing knot at the vanishing point
levels.caption: spacetime as a mesh curved by gravitational wells and rippled by an orbiting pair, with strings vibrating in standing waves between two sheets and a Calabi-Yau cross section at the horizon. illustrative geometry, not a solution of general relativity or evidence for string theory

levels.label: forces
levels.alt: golden lines burst from a bright central point: looping orbits around a star at the upper left, field lines running to a charge at the upper right, a cluster of glowing spheres forming a nucleus at the lower left, and dotted spiral tracks curling at the lower right
levels.caption: the four forces from one point: gravity's precessing orbits, electric field lines and their equipotentials, a strong-force flux tube ending in a nucleus, and weak decays traced as bubble-chamber spirals. each follows its own law, since the forces don't share one equation

levels.label: interconnection
levels.alt: a magenta mandala in a circular frame: wavy rings of glowing sand around a petaled core of soft light, with fine lotus curves and stardust spreading beyond the rim
levels.caption: Chladni sand settled on the still lines of a vibrating drum, around the electron density of a hydrogen orbital, framed as a lotus. the parallel it draws between physics and spiritual symbols is symbolic, not a scientific equivalence

levels.label: oneness
levels.alt: a glowing gold sphere at the center, its dotted surface rippling, wrapped in a coiled halo and surrounded by looping field lines, faint wavefronts and drifting gold dust
levels.caption: a sphere vibrating with a spherical harmonic, inside dipole field lines, spreading wavefronts and a torus-knot halo. a visual metaphor for a metaphysical idea of unity, not accepted cosmology

tracks.concept: how change becomes measurement, asymmetry and causality
how vibration becomes listening, music and emotion
how distinctions become signals, codes and computation

levels.label: encoding
levels.alt: rows of small violet squares at the top drop thin lines into a grid of sixteen columns of seven squares, some lit and some dark, with three bands paler than the rest; one square in the grid is ringed, and a line runs from it through three small squares to three overlapping circles below, two of them bright, where the same square is ringed in the overlap of the bright circles
levels.caption: the word encoding split into 4-bit symbols and sent as Hamming(7,4) codewords: three parity bits per codeword, at positions 1, 2 and 4, each making even the positions it checks. one received bit is flipped, the two checks it breaks spell its position in binary, and the code's Venn diagram finds it where the failing circles meet

tracks.concept: how simple rules produce instability, complexity and limits to prediction

levels.label: order
levels.alt: a deep blue vortex: about a hundred and fifty faint points scattered over a dark plane, each trailing a line that winds inward in a tightening oval spiral to one bright point at the centre, over a faint grid of short strokes that show the flow
levels.caption: a damped Duffing oscillator, a stiff spring with friction, drawn in its phase plane of position and velocity. a hundred and fifty starting states, scattered at random, are each integrated step by step, and friction drains every one of them into the same resting point, a stable attractor. the short strokes are the vector field that steers them. a stable fixed point is one kind of order, not the only one a dynamical system can have

levels.label: motion
levels.alt: a blue-gray eye of nested rings on a dark ground: small ellipses at the centre grow into pointed eye outlines, with dots strung along every ring and faint lines through them that run straight out from the centre and curl near the edge; wavy lines pass above and below the eye
levels.caption: the phase portrait of a frictionless pendulum, angle across and momentum up: each closed curve is one swing, and near the bottom they are the ellipses of a harmonic oscillator. every swing starts at its widest point at the same moment, and the dots mark where each one is at equal steps of time. small swings keep pace, so the lines through equal times are straight, while larger swings take longer and fall behind, so the lines curl. outside the eye, the pendulum goes over the top. this motion is fully predictable, but a deterministic law alone does not make every system so

levels.label: instability
levels.alt: a red butterfly of looping lines in two wings: a single dim line winds through both, then splits into a red line and a pale line that take different loops, ending far apart; below, a faint chart shows a wavering line climbing steadily from left to right
levels.caption: two runs of the Lorenz system that start a millionth apart, integrated step by step. they trace one path for about fifteen loops, then part, and their distance, charted below on a log scale, grows at a steady exponential rate until it is as large as the attractor. the Lorenz system is one chaotic example: not every nonlinear system behaves this way

levels.label: nonlinearity
levels.alt: an orange cascade on a dark ground: a single thin line falls from the top and splits into an arch, then into four and eight lines, and then into a broad spray of fine curved strands crossed by dark bands; a thin wavering trace runs down a narrow column on the right
levels.caption: the bifurcation diagram of the logistic map, x to r x (1 - x), with r growing downward. for each r, many starting values are iterated, the early steps are dropped and the rest are counted, so the brightness shows where the map keeps returning. the cycle doubles again and again, then turns chaotic, with windows of order inside the chaos. the trace on the right is the Lyapunov exponent: right of its line, nearby starts drift apart. the logistic map is a mathematical example, not a map of every real system

levels.label: emergence
levels.alt: three turquoise panels, one above the other, of small agents drawn as short trails with bright heads: at the top they are scattered and point every way, in the middle they move in several small groups, each with its own heading, and at the bottom nearly all of them move together as one flock beside a small group
levels.caption: Reynolds boids: each of 120 agents sees only its near neighbours, and steers to match their heading, to move toward them and to keep from crowding them. nothing steers the whole, yet from random starts they form groups, and the groups one flock, shown at three moments. the world wraps at its edges, so each panel is centred on its largest group. flocking is one form of emergence, and the model does not explain every complex social system

levels.label: complexity
levels.alt: violet outlines of branching, maze-like clusters on a dark ground, from small rings to large coral-like masses that touch and merge, with tiny lights scattered along their outer edges
levels.caption: the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion model, solved on a grid: two chemicals that react and spread at different rates grow branching clusters from drops placed at different times, so young rings sit beside old masses. the lights mark where the pattern grew most recently. the shapes look organic, but they come from the model, not from any living thing

levels.label: uncertainty
levels.alt: a gold line zigzags up from a bright point at the bottom, then frays near the top into a fan of many fainter strands that spread across the whole width, crossed by faint horizontal rules and a dashed one
levels.caption: an ensemble forecast of the Lorenz system, the model of chaos.3: 240 runs start within a thousandth of one present state, and time rises upward. each faint rule marks the moment the runs' spread has grown tenfold again, and the dashed one the forecast horizon, where the spread is as wide as the attractor and the forecast says no more than the system's range. every run follows the same law: the spread comes from sensitivity to a small uncertainty in the start, not from any absence of cause

tracks.concept: how expression becomes signals, language and understanding
how curiosity becomes rules, strategy and freedom
